summary: Accepted for the exact source digest reviewed. The refreshed legacy TD-derived EC inventory contains 91 required behavior cases covering the DeveloperTool capability claims and required behavior dimension. The prior four defects are closed by five added exact cases: separate EC-first phase routing, phase-less admission, and remote-ledger proofs; a configured required-EC red-to-green terminal fixture; a public goal convergence fixture that reaches CB fill/check and required EC; and real-listener HTTP/1.1+h2c plus service-http delegation proofs. Assertions pin concrete commands, phases, refusal/closure state, consulted-case evidence, protocol responses, and router bodies. The oracles are independently defined in exact test/fixture expectations rather than aw ec or the implementation's own reported truth. Every re-reviewed selector executed exactly one test; all seven relevant exact tests passed, including the two localhost listener cases, so no empty-filter or trivial-behavior loophole remains.
